messages.text: What evidence is required to compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense without making unsupported claims?

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, we need cited evidence for four things: the Aerospace / Defense use case, our exact product configuration and warranted specs, the competitor’s exact product configuration and warranted specs, and a source that directly supports the comparison claim; the current passages show A&D context and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer mentions, but they do not provide a supported competitor comparison for that A&D solution [97][99][10][25].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | What must be documented | Why it is required | Current passage support / gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense application evidence | A source that explicitly ties the target A&D test scenario to the needed measurements, standards, DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, uncertainty, and pass/fail criteria | The current RAW evidence only shows “Aerospace & Defense Test” and separately lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” without a full test requirement or comparison context [97][99] | DO-160 and military drone EMC passages are only solution/standard leads and explicitly warn not to infer full categories, limits, waveforms, setups, pass/fail criteria, or required UAV/eVTOL test items from them [15][17] |
| Our Signal Generator configuration | Exact R&S generator model, options, frequency range, modulation bandwidth, fading/channel emulation options, and ordering constraints | SMW200A facts depend on configuration: RF path A can reach 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B can reach 100 kHz to 44 GHz, wideband baseband RF modulation bandwidth can reach 2 GHz, and the base unit must be ordered with an RF path A frequency option plus B13/B13T/B13XT baseband main module [61][64] | Product positioning and architecture are supported for SMW200A, including up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths with SGT100A modules, and standard vs wideband baseband bandwidth differences [1] |
| Our Signal Analyzer configuration | Exact R&S analyzer model, frequency range, analysis bandwidth option, firmware options, and operating/specification conditions | FSW model frequency ranges vary from FSW8 through FSW85, with FSW85 extendable to 90 GHz using FSW-B90G, and analysis bandwidth options range from 40 MHz through 8.312 GHz depending on option and model applicability [69][6] | FSW specifications also require defined product-data conditions such as 3 hours ambient storage, 30 minutes warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal adjustments where applicable [66] |
| Warranted-spec evidence | Datasheet/specification claims must distinguish warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable data | SMW200A specifications with and without limits represent warranted product performance, while n. trc., typ., nom., and meas. values are not guaranteed [3] | FSV3000/SMBV100B passages show the same type of caution: typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable values are not warranted, and data without tolerance limits is not binding [44][49] |
| Our A&D-relevant measurement method evidence | A source that links SMW200A + FSW to the actual A&D-relevant measurement, not just a generic product capability | For satellite payload testing, R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing, including group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality [56] | The satellite payload application brochure positions FSW + SMW200A for complete payload testing, but it is an application/solution brochure and must not replace product datasheets for options, order numbers, or specification conditions [52][55] |
| Competitor identity and official configuration | Competitor vendor, model, option codes, order numbers, release status, datasheet version, test conditions, and supported configuration | The Keysight-related battle card lacks official Keysight datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions for the UXM SKUs [10] | Keysight UXM descriptions in the passages are from an R&S battle card and are explicitly not Keysight official data [78][79] |
| Competitor performance evidence | Competitor frequency range, bandwidth, phase noise, modulation/fading/channel emulation capability, analysis bandwidth, measurement apps, uncertainty, and calibration conditions from official or independent sources | The passages say the R&S battle card’s Keysight competitor descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data validation [10] | The battle card has unresolved items and uses sales language such as only, first, leadership, lower TCO, and fewer boxes, which require formal evidence before use in technical comparison or customer documents [25] |
| Direct comparison evidence | A cited source that compares the same use case, same measurement conditions, same DUT class, same configuration level, and same metric for both sides | The current passages do not provide a direct A&D Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer comparison against a competitor; they provide R&S product/application facts and separate competitor-related limitations [10][25][52][56] | Separate co-mentions such as “Aerospace & Defense Test” and “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer” are not enough to substantiate a competitor comparison claim because the passages do not state a competitor or comparison result [97][99] |
| Standards / qualification evidence | The formal standard version, procurement requirement, qualification plan, test category, limit table, waveform, setup, and pass/fail criteria | DO-160 content in the passages is not a formal standard summary and must not be used to infer complete section categories, limits, waveforms, setups, or pass/fail criteria [15] | Military UAV EMC/EME content is also a market-slide summary, not MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, or RTCA DO-160 documentation, and cannot determine which tests any drone/UAV/eVTOL must perform [17] |
| Scenario and signal model evidence | Signal library, scenario definition, emitter/threat model, power, frequency band, synchronization, safety, and regulatory conditions | The complex EME emulation passage supports a custom test direction but explicitly lacks signal library, scenario definition, threat emitter model, power, band, synchronization, and safety conditions [18] | Without those details, an A&D EME comparison would be a scenario concept rather than a substantiated product comparison [18] |
| Commercial / support evidence | Price, service contract, calibration plan, export control, availability, and configuration tool validation | NTN recommended configurations are presentation recommendations and do not include price, service contract, calibration, full accessories, export control, or latest option availability [90] | FSWX configuration notes also say actual orderable combinations and upgrade feasibility require checking original PDF/configure tool and serial-number-specific conditions [48] |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. A formal A&D test requirement or customer/procurement test plan naming the standard, DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, waveform/scenario, limits, uncertainty, and pass/fail criteria, because the current DO-160 and military drone passages explicitly cannot supply complete limits, categories, setups, or required test items [15][17].  
2. Our exact R&S configuration with datasheet-backed model/options, because SMW200A and FSW capabilities depend on RF path, baseband, fading, analysis bandwidth, firmware, and option applicability [1][61][62][6][69][70].  
3. Competitor official or third-party validated datasheets for the exact competitor configuration, because the available Keysight competitor material is an R&S battle card and lacks official datasheets, option lists, order numbers, versions, release status, and test conditions [10][78][79].  
4. A like-for-like comparison matrix using only supported metrics under the same conditions, because the available battle card contains unresolved sales-language claims that require formal evidence before use in technical comparison or customer documents [25].  
5. Application-level evidence tying the instruments to the target measurement, because the passages support FSW + SMW200A for satellite payload complete payload testing, but they also say application brochures must not replace product datasheets for options, order numbers, or specification conditions [56][55].  
### Current safe statement
The passages support saying that R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended in a satellite payload testing application for complete payload testing covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality, but the passages do not support a competitor comparison for an Aerospace / Defense Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution without additional competitor official or third-party validated evidence [56][10][25].

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › 規格適用條件與語彙
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）：

- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage `3 hours` 後 warm-up operation `30 minutes`、符合 specified environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval、完成所有 applicable internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 與 specifications without limits 代表 warranted product performance。

- 依 3GPP standard，本文件中的 `Gbps`、`Mcps`、`Mbps`、`Msps`、`kbps`、`ksps`、`Msample/s` 不是 SI units。

- RF switching matrix
- signal analyzer
- network analyzer
- multimeter
- DC power system
- laptop / PC remote operation
- test interface
- TVAC
- satellite or satellite components
- bulkhead connector interface

來源標示 TVAC setup 中距離為 10 m to 25 m。

TVAC 衛星酬載測試 › 測試問題
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]（September 2022，Version 02.00）：

- Satellite payload qualification 需要使用 [[TVAC]] 進行 performance testing。
- Commercial off-the-shelf test and measurement equipment 無法在 TVAC conditions 下工作。
- Spectrum analyzers、vector network analyzers、signal generators 等設備必須留在 TVAC 外部，並以長 cables 連接 chamber 內的 DUT。
- Test setup 中的 cables、adapters 與 switches 會隨 TVAC temperature changes 發生 drift。
- 在不同 temperature 下於 chamber 中完成的 calibration 不再有效。
- 移動 cables 與改變 temperatures 後，需要 regular recalibration 以確保 measurement accuracy。
- TVAC 內 calibration procedure 特別困難，因 vacuum applied 時 operator 無法進入 chamber。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 方法選擇
依 [[Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200]]：

- [[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 建議用於 complete payload testing。
- [[R&S ZNA]] 建議用於 component level testing。
- Spectrum analyzer + signal generator 的 measuring principle 是產生 multi-carrier signal，量測 carriers 之間的 phase shift / difference，再計算 group delay。
- VNA 的 measuring principle 是產生 two-tone signal，並在 reference 與 measurement receivers 中量測 carriers 之間的 phase。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 測量原理
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 產生 multi-carrier continuous wave signal 作為 stimulus。
- Multi-carrier stimulus 的 tones 數量與 spacing / aperture 可依 DUT 需求調整。
- [[R&S FSW]] 的 group delay measurement 分兩步：
  - Reference calibration：generator 直接連接 analyzer，analyzer 判定 individual carriers 的 reference phase 與 amplitude。
  - Group delay and gain measurement：連接 DUT，analyzer 由 reference signal 與 DUT output multicarrier signal 的 phase difference 判定 carrier frequency range 的 group delay。
- 來源列出使用 [[R&S SMW-K61]] 與 [[R&S FSW-K17]] multicarrier group delay measurement application。

衛星酬載群延遲量測 › 來源列出的優點
- 可在 milliseconds 內量測 wideband signals 的 absolute group delay 與 relative group delay。
- Signal averaging 與 smoothing 可改善 carrier-to-noise ratio，在 cables 與 fixtures 導致 high signal path losses 時取得 valid results。
- 可自動補償 in-orbit measurements 的 Doppler effects。
- Frequency converters 的 relative group delay 可達 1 ns measurement accuracy，且不需要 reference mixer 或 golden device。
- Non-frequency-translating measurements 的 relative group delay 可達 300 ps measurement accuracy。
- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可內部彈性產生 MCCW signals 與 modulated signals，並可設定 carrier spacing 與 number of carriers。
- Deembedding function 可修正 measurement setup 中 cables 與 fixtures 的 frequency response。
- [[R&S FSW-K17S]] option 可量測 low SNR 的 wideband signals，透過分析 overall signal 的 subspans 改善 SNR 與 measurement speeds。

- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。

### Short answer
To compare our Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution with a competitor for Aerospace / Defense, we need cited evidence for four things: the Aerospace / Defense use case, our exact product configuration and warranted specs, the competitor’s exact product configuration and warranted specs, and a source that directly supports the comparison claim; the current passages show A&D context and Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer mentions, but they do not provide a supported competitor comparison for that A&D solution [97][99][10][25].
### Evidence required
| Evidence required | What must be documented | Why it is required | Current passage support / gap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Aerospace / Defense application evidence | A source that explicitly ties the target A&D test scenario to the needed measurements, standards, DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, uncertainty, and pass/fail criteria | The current RAW evidence only shows “Aerospace & Defense Test” and separately lists “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer,” without a full test requirement or comparison context [97][99] | DO-160 and military drone EMC passages are only solution/standard leads and explicitly warn not to infer full categories, limits, waveforms, setups, pass/fail criteria, or required UAV/eVTOL test items from them [15][17] |
| Our Signal Generator configuration | Exact R&S generator model, options, frequency range, modulation bandwidth, fading/channel emulation options, and ordering constraints | SMW200A facts depend on configuration: RF path A can reach 100 kHz to 67 GHz, RF path B can reach 100 kHz to 44 GHz, wideband baseband RF modulation bandwidth can reach 2 GHz, and the base unit must be ordered with an RF path A frequency option plus B13/B13T/B13XT baseband main module [61][64] | Product positioning and architecture are supported for SMW200A, including up to 8 signal sources, up to 64 fading channels, up to 8 RF paths with SGT100A modules, and standard vs wideband baseband bandwidth differences [1] |
| Our Signal Analyzer configuration | Exact R&S analyzer model, frequency range, analysis bandwidth option, firmware options, and operating/specification conditions | FSW model frequency ranges vary from FSW8 through FSW85, with FSW85 extendable to 90 GHz using FSW-B90G, and analysis bandwidth options range from 40 MHz through 8.312 GHz depending on option and model applicability [69][6] | FSW specifications also require defined product-data conditions such as 3 hours ambient storage, 30 minutes warm-up, environmental conditions, calibration interval, and internal adjustments where applicable [66] |
| Warranted-spec evidence | Datasheet/specification claims must distinguish warranted specifications from typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable data | SMW200A specifications with and without limits represent warranted product performance, while n. trc., typ., nom., and meas. values are not guaranteed [3] | FSV3000/SMBV100B passages show the same type of caution: typical, nominal, measured, or non-traceable values are not warranted, and data without tolerance limits is not binding [44][49] |
| Our A&D-relevant measurement method evidence | A source that links SMW200A + FSW to the actual A&D-relevant measurement, not just a generic product capability | For satellite payload testing, R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended for complete payload testing, including group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality [56] | The satellite payload application brochure positions FSW + SMW200A for complete payload testing, but it is an application/solution brochure and must not replace product datasheets for options, order numbers, or specification conditions [52][55] |
| Competitor identity and official configuration | Competitor vendor, model, option codes, order numbers, release status, datasheet version, test conditions, and supported configuration | The Keysight-related battle card lacks official Keysight datasheets, document versions, order numbers, option codes, release status, and test conditions for the UXM SKUs [10] | Keysight UXM descriptions in the passages are from an R&S battle card and are explicitly not Keysight official data [78][79] |
| Competitor performance evidence | Competitor frequency range, bandwidth, phase noise, modulation/fading/channel emulation capability, analysis bandwidth, measurement apps, uncertainty, and calibration conditions from official or independent sources | The passages say the R&S battle card’s Keysight competitor descriptions need Keysight official data or third-party data validation [10] | The battle card has unresolved items and uses sales language such as only, first, leadership, lower TCO, and fewer boxes, which require formal evidence before use in technical comparison or customer documents [25] |
| Direct comparison evidence | A cited source that compares the same use case, same measurement conditions, same DUT class, same configuration level, and same metric for both sides | The current passages do not provide a direct A&D Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer comparison against a competitor; they provide R&S product/application facts and separate competitor-related limitations [10][25][52][56] | Separate co-mentions such as “Aerospace & Defense Test” and “Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer” are not enough to substantiate a competitor comparison claim because the passages do not state a competitor or comparison result [97][99] |
| Standards / qualification evidence | The formal standard version, procurement requirement, qualification plan, test category, limit table, waveform, setup, and pass/fail criteria | DO-160 content in the passages is not a formal standard summary and must not be used to infer complete section categories, limits, waveforms, setups, or pass/fail criteria [15] | Military UAV EMC/EME content is also a market-slide summary, not MIL-STD-461, MIL-STD-464, or RTCA DO-160 documentation, and cannot determine which tests any drone/UAV/eVTOL must perform [17] |
| Scenario and signal model evidence | Signal library, scenario definition, emitter/threat model, power, frequency band, synchronization, safety, and regulatory conditions | The complex EME emulation passage supports a custom test direction but explicitly lacks signal library, scenario definition, threat emitter model, power, band, synchronization, and safety conditions [18] | Without those details, an A&D EME comparison would be a scenario concept rather than a substantiated product comparison [18] |
| Commercial / support evidence | Price, service contract, calibration plan, export control, availability, and configuration tool validation | NTN recommended configurations are presentation recommendations and do not include price, service contract, calibration, full accessories, export control, or latest option availability [90] | FSWX configuration notes also say actual orderable combinations and upgrade feasibility require checking original PDF/configure tool and serial-number-specific conditions [48] |
### Minimum evidence package before making the comparison
1. A formal A&D test requirement or customer/procurement test plan naming the standard, DUT, frequency range, bandwidth, waveform/scenario, limits, uncertainty, and pass/fail criteria, because the current DO-160 and military drone passages explicitly cannot supply complete limits, categories, setups, or required test items [15][17].  
2. Our exact R&S configuration with datasheet-backed model/options, because SMW200A and FSW capabilities depend on RF path, baseband, fading, analysis bandwidth, firmware, and option applicability [1][61][62][6][69][70].  
3. Competitor official or third-party validated datasheets for the exact competitor configuration, because the available Keysight competitor material is an R&S battle card and lacks official datasheets, option lists, order numbers, versions, release status, and test conditions [10][78][79].  
4. A like-for-like comparison matrix using only supported metrics under the same conditions, because the available battle card contains unresolved sales-language claims that require formal evidence before use in technical comparison or customer documents [25].  
5. Application-level evidence tying the instruments to the target measurement, because the passages support FSW + SMW200A for satellite payload complete payload testing, but they also say application brochures must not replace product datasheets for options, order numbers, or specification conditions [56][55].  
### Current safe statement
The passages support saying that R&S FSW + R&S SMW200A are recommended in a satellite payload testing application for complete payload testing covering group delay, linearity, NPR, modulation, OFDM, spurious, and signal quality, but the passages do not support a competitor comparison for an Aerospace / Defense Signal Generator / Signal Analyzer solution without additional competitor official or third-party validated evidence [56][10][25].

- Product data 適用條件：ambient temperature 下 storage 3 hours、warm-up operation 30 minutes、specified environmental conditions met、recommended calibration interval adhered to、all applicable internal automatic adjustments performed。
- Specifications with limits 代表 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、± 或 maximum / limit of / minimum 等方式表示。
- Specifications with limits 的符合性由 testing 確保，或由 design 推導；test limits 會以 guard bands 收窄以納入 measurement uncertainties、drift、aging。

Satellite_payload_testing_app-bro_en_5215-2120-92_v0200 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 Rohde & Schwarz application brochure《Satellite payload and components testing》，文件代碼 `PD 5215.2120.92`，Version 02.00，文件日期標示 `September 2022 (ch)`，主題是使用 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 儀器測試 [[衛星酬載與元件測試]]、transponders、modules 與 components。

- 衛星通訊系統支援 direct broadcast、wireless communications、remote sensing，涵蓋 commercial 與 government systems，並要求 24/7 reliable operation 與 multi-decade system longevity。
- 來源將 payload 技術演進描述為從 bent-pipe 或 digital transparent payloads 進展到 digital regenerative payloads；regenerative payloads 增加 system capacity 與 flexibility，但也增加 testing complexity。
- Bent-pipe payload channel 高階組成包含 uplink antenna、low noise amplifier、filter、frequency converter、filter、high power amplifier、filter、downlink antenna 與 local oscillator。
- Regenerative payload channel 在 RF chain 中加入 digital demodulator、baseband processing and switching、digital modulator 等功能區塊。
- 來源定位 [[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S SMW200A]] 與 [[R&S ZNA]] 為 satellite payload / component RF testing 的核心儀器：[[R&S FSW]] + [[R&S SMW200A]] 偏 complete payload testing，[[R&S ZNA]] 偏 component level testing。
- [[衛星酬載群延遲量測]] 是主要測試主題之一；來源比較 multi-carrier group delay measurement 與 [[R&S ZNA]] two-tone technique。
- Linearity and gain transfer measurements 涵蓋 gain compression、AM/AM、AM/PM、NPR、ACLR、DPD 與 EVM 等 payload / component characterization。
- [[TVAC 衛星酬載測試]] 使用 chamber 外部測試儀器、長 cables、inline calibration modules 與 TVAC-compatible power sensors，以處理 temperature drift 與 vacuum 下無法人工進入 chamber 的 calibration 問題。
- Digital interface testing 涵蓋 [[SpaceWire]]、8b/10b-based [[SpaceFibre]]、MIL-STD-1553、ARINC 429、CAN、I²C/SPI、UART 等 bus trigger/decode/debug 測試。
